_about: RAMP InterActive associations whose whole season is read into the game list every day: league games (/api/leaguegame/get/{aid}/{sid}/0/0/0/0/) and team-entered exhibitions (/api/portalgame/get/{aid}/{sid}/0/0/0/0/0). aid = association id, sid = the 2026-27 season id (from the site's season menu). Game pages open at {host}/division/{cat}/{div}/gamesheet/{GID}.
